## tmh webhook-subscriptions update

Update a webhook subscription

### Synopsis

Updates a webhook subscription; parameters you don't send are left unchanged. Send its current `ETag` in `If-Match`. The signing secret doesn't change. Requires the `webhooks:manage` or `org:admin` scope.

Fields you leave out keep their current values. Clear description with -d description:=null.

Scopes: org:admin or webhooks:manage

```
tmh webhook-subscriptions update <subscriptionId> [flags]
```

      --description string              A description for your own reference.
      --enabled                         Turn deliveries on or off.
      --endpoint-url string             The HTTPS URL to deliver events to.
      --event-types strings             The event types to deliver; one of: enrollment.certified, seat.consumed, seat.freed, learner.invited, learner.started, learner.certified, learner.expiring, learner.expired, learner.removed, invite.bounced, certificate.revoked, seats.low
  -h, --help                            help for update
